newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: First Austrian chief exec resigns.
newsitem.headline: First Austrian chief exec resigns.

text.p: Konrad Fuchs has decided to step down as chief executive of Die Erste Oesterreichische Spar-Casse Bank (First Austrian) in the middle of this year, the bank said on Monday.

Fuchs, 59, was leaving at his own request after 25 years as a board member and eight years as chief executive, the bank said. It had invited Fuchs to stay on as a member of the supervisory board and as an advisor.

First Austrian, the nation's third biggest bank in terms of total assets, failed earlier this year in a bid to buy into rival Creditanstalt-Bankverein. It was pipped at the post by market leader Bank Austria.
First Austrian said it would decide on a replacement for Fuchs in the coming weeks.
